layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Hadrosaurid duck-bill morphology
features: A dinosaur head with a wide, flat, duck-like clay beak at the front of the mouth
The beak is a pale tan clay with vertical ridges and a slightly worn texture
The head is slightly open, showing a simple clay tongue and a glimpse of grinding teeth further back in the jaw
The skin is made of pebbly, green and brown clay with a small fleshy crest on top of the head
Large, gentle dark eyes with realistic clay eyelids
layer_3_action.action: A 3/4 profile bust shot of the clay hadrosaur. The lighting is bright and clear to showcase the unique 'duck-bill' shape as a morphology icon. Neutral grey background. No text.
